title: The Quiet Chamber Where Argument Learns to Rest

features.name: the voteless rows
features.desc-on-touch: Trees in ordered silence. Each one has spoken its portion. Each one is at peace. The parliament has become a plantation—argument transformed into growth, row after patient row.

features.name: the fence between speakers
features.desc-on-touch: Once it divided voices. Now it holds them together. The posts are worn smooth by agreement. The rails have learned to be patient.

features.name: the final tally, stone
features.desc-on-touch: The vote concluded. The sum was written into stone and then the stone learned to forget what the numbers meant. The debate has become geology.

inscription: the parliament discovered that silence was the only vote that never needed to be counted again
